items.quote: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
items.claim: Moses and Aaron numbered Levite males aged one month and upward, totaling 22,000
items.object: the Levites (all males from a month old and upward)
items.mechanism: at the commandment of the LORD
